verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs explicitly describe drag-and-drop folder deploys with no login/Git required (netlify-docs-2, netlify-docs-4) and CLI-based anonymous deploys (netlify-docs-3), plus explicit confirmation that new projects stay private until published (netlify-docs-4). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the private-until-publish behavior and more detail on how/when publishing is triggered.
